name: drive.list_files
description: List files in the governed Drive

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query applied within the governed Drive

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of files to return

name: drive.get_file
description: Read metadata for a single file in the governed Drive

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: File identifier within the governed Drive

name: docs.get_document
description: Read a document's content from the governed Docs workspace

parameters.name: document_id
parameters.description: Document identifier within the governed Docs workspace

parameters.name: plain_text
parameters.description: Return plain text instead of structured content

name: drive_create_doc
description: Create a new Google Doc from Markdown inside a Drive folder. Use when the user asks to publish, upload, or save a document to a Drive folder and gives the folder id. The user sees a preview and must confirm it before anything is written, so call it once with the full content and never claim the doc was written until the result says so.

parameters.name: folder_id
parameters.description: Id of the parent Drive folder the new doc goes in

parameters.name: markdown
parameters.description: Full document content in Markdown; Drive converts it to a Google Doc

name: drive_update_doc
description: Replace the content of an existing Google Doc with Markdown. Use when the user asks to update, overwrite, or republish a doc and gives the doc id. The user sees a preview and must confirm it before anything is written, so call it once with the full content and never claim the doc was written until the result says so.

parameters.name: doc_id
parameters.description: Id of the Google Doc to replace

parameters.name: markdown
parameters.description: Full document content in Markdown; Drive converts it to a Google Doc
